Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reaching out. I’m happy to address your questions regarding the contract.

Regarding the payment terms, we can certainly discuss moving from net-60 to net-30. I will check with our finance team to see if an exception can be made for this project, and I’ll get back to you shortly with an update.

As for the non-compete clause, I understand your concern about it being restrictive. We are open to discussing adjustments to make it more equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call later this week to review the specific language and find a middle ground that works for both parties.

On a separate note, since this is a priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Let me know what time works best for you to discuss the contract details.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
